title: useOptimistic and pending UI: Render a temporary optimistic entry during an Action while retaining authoritative committed state separately
description: A practical React 19 lesson for useoptimistic and pending ui, with an intentionally failing starter, complete TypeScript instructor implementation, local assertions and honest runtime scope.
objectives: Render a temporary optimistic entry during an Action while retaining authoritative committed state separately.
Repair the broken behavior in the react-use-optimistic starter.
Demonstrate correct and edge-case outcomes using offline tests.
rubric: I can articulate the React 19 contract for useoptimistic and pending ui.
I can reproduce, repair and test the 06.04.05 starter case.
